latest.headline: StoryVS_TTV Extends Mastery in Mexico
latest.paragraph: StoryVS_TTV produced an impeccable performance at the Mexico round, securing a perfect record with wins on all six stages. Completing the rally in 00:51:41.991, they comfortably claimed the top step of the podium ahead of GTI_1990, who finished second, and Janeman13, who rounded out the top three. While the field faced various penalties and technical setbacks throughout the six stages, the leader remained unchallenged throughout the event. This clean sweep of stage victories marks a significant display of consistency for the Hyundai driver as they continue their campaign in the WRC2 category.
